mostWorthwhile.text: Building the membrane from fats and water was most worthwhile: the two-layer picture explained how the boundary is arranged.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the sugar carrier was clear but fairly predictable after making the water channel, and it was the only offered combination.

surprise.text: Oxygen crossed both ways, even though more entered the cell. I had expected it to pass in, but hadn't thought about movement in both directions.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures connected each pairing to a route across the membrane. Some later choices were simply the only available combinations.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter: the pictures made the cell boundary understandable, though I hope there would be more meaningful choices than the mostly predictable pairings here.
